Title: Generally Available: Autoscale for vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB

Body.Content:
Now you can handle peak loads effortlessly without overprovisioning using the new autoscale capability, currently available for vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB. Autoscaling gives you instantaneous scalability—your database can quickly adapt to changes in demand and peak loads without delays. Resources are available when your application needs them. Additionally, you pay only for the resources you use, giving you more flexibility to control costs.  

 

Learn more.
